# META — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q1 2026 earnings (Apr 29 AH) remain the controlling catalyst on Day 5–6 of the post-print re-rating window. Capex guidance of **$125–145B** (nearly double FY2025's $72B) continues to drive institutional selling. Markets recovered May 5 (S&P +0.7%, Nasdaq +1% intraday ATH) despite ongoing Iran-UAE/Strait of Hormuz conflict — but oil remains above $102/bbl. **New catalyst since May 4:** New Mexico seeks $3.7B and full platform overhaul in youth-harm trial starting May 2026; Reuters Pulitzer Prize reporting on harmful AI chatbots exposed to children and fraudulent ads adds fresh reputational pressure. No new binary until Q2 2026 earnings (~July 29). (source: web_research/META.json, run 20260505_140723)

## Live catalysts

| Event | Date | Significance |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 2026 post-earnings re-rating window | Apr 29 – ~May 9 | HIGH — capex shock still being absorbed; multiple compression ongoing |
| New Mexico $3.7B youth-harm trial | Started May 2026 | HIGH NEGATIVE — new; seeks platform overhaul + $3.7B; Reuters Pulitzer deepens reputational risk |
| Iran-UAE conflict / Strait of Hormuz | Ongoing (active as of May 5) | HIGH NEGATIVE — oil >$102/bbl; market recovered May 5 but tail risk active |
| Fed Chair transition (Powell → Warsh) | May 15 | MEDIUM NEGATIVE — hawkish succession; policy uncertainty for high-multiple tech |
| Snap Q1 2026 earnings | ~May 6 | MEDIUM — read-through for digital ad market health; Snap swung to Q1 profit ($45M) |
| Layoff restructuring (~8,000 employees / 10% workforce) | Ongoing (Apr–May 2026) | MEDIUM — cost discipline signal; 6,000 open roles frozen |
| Social media addiction litigation | Ongoing | HIGH NEGATIVE — CA 70% liability verdict, 10,000+ suits, NM $375M award + new $3.7B trial |
| Q2 2026 earnings | ~July 29, 2026 | MEDIUM — consensus revenue estimate $59.48B (+23% CC growth, decelerating from 29%) |

## Recent news (as of May 5, 2026)

**New Mexico $3.7B trial (HIGH NEGATIVE):** New Mexico is seeking $3.7B and a full platform overhaul from Meta in a youth-harm trial starting May 2026. Combined with the CA 70% liability verdict and existing $375M NM award, litigation exposure is compounding. (source: web_research/META.json ticker_news, run 20260505_140723)

**Reuters Pulitzer Prize (HIGH NEGATIVE):** Reuters won a Pulitzer for beat reporting on Meta — specifically harmful AI chatbots exposed to children and billions made from fraudulent ads. Reputational and regulatory risk elevated. (source: web_research/META.json ticker_news, run 20260505_140723)

**Market recovery May 5 (CONTEXT):** S&P +0.7%, Nasdaq +1% intraday ATH on May 5 despite Iran conflict. Partial risk-on offset to prior day's sell-off. Short position opened at unfavorable timing relative to market recovery; watchfor $618–621 resistance retest. (source: web_research/META.json macro_context, run 20260505_140723)

**Capex / JPMorgan downgrade (unchanged from May 4):** Capex $125–145B confirmed. JPMorgan Neutral ($725 PT). Analyst consensus broadly bullish (61B/6H/0S, avg PT $839) but pre-absorption consensus. Meta on track to surpass Google in digital ad revenue 2026 — ad business structural positive. (source: web_research/META.json, run 20260505_140723)

## Format

Each lesson is one dated bullet:

`[DATE] | [TICKER] | [SETUP TYPE] | [OUTCOME: +$X / -$X] | [WHY it worked or failed in 1 sentence]`

The "why" should reference: the thesis at the time, the macro regime, which swing strategy recommended it.

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
